ns2:course.label: Advanced Marketing Management
ns2:course.description: Integrative study of methods and models for marketing decision-making; emphasizes the application of analytical tools and behavioral and quantitative models to marketing decision-making. Uses lectures, case studies and simulation exercises. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: BADM 320 and Senior standing.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: No graduate credit. Prerequisite: BADM 320 and Senior standing.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to College of Business. Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
